tāla
------------------------------------------
See MŪRTIŚILPAŚĀSTRA.
Tāla also means time-measure in मुसिच्. See SAṄGĪTA.

Talavakāras
(‘those who keep time [while chanting]’)
------------------------------------------
See KENA UPANIṢAD.

Talātala
------------------------------------------
This is the fourth of the nether worlds. मय, the chief engineer and architect of the demons, lives here.
He is being protected by शिव himself.
Terrible serpents known as the Krodhavaśa also live here. The more well-known among them are Kuhaka, तक्षक, Kāliya and Suṣeṇa.
